reference_price_basis: Last completed U.S. regular-session close, 2026-09-11. Values are analyst estimates, not targets. Current price does not change scenario economics.
method: 10-year per-share owner-cash DCF. Years 1-5 and 6-10 growth rates are explicit by scenario; terminal value is year-10 owner cash times an explicit multiple. Starting owner cash uses reported OCF less disclosed capex where usable, with explicit normalization for Intuit cash-tax timing. No probability precision is asserted.

notes: Starting owner cash annualizes nine-month 2026 OCF less purchases of property/equipment/technology.
Current price is about 8.6% above Base but materially below Bull; price does not require Bull-only execution.
Starting owner cash annualizes H1 OCF less PPE purchases and capitalized software.

Starting owner cash is FY2026 free cash flow divided by diluted shares after the 10-for-1 split.
Current price is far above Base and requires roughly 21% owner-cash growth for five years under the Base terminal multiple, but remains below an aggressive yet plausible AI/WFE Bull case.
Starting owner cash is FY2026 OCF less capex/intangibles divided by shares outstanding.
